daily_brief: Trilateral peace talks between Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have begun in Abu Dhabi, with European allies insisting on participation amid concerns about territorial concessions [BBC], [RFI], [France 24]. The talks come as US officials report 'some flexibility' from both Moscow and Kyiv on the contested Donetsk region. In Washington, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces an impeachment resolution from outgoing Republican Representative Thomas Massie over the conduct of military operations against Iran, which Hegseth denounced as 'sabotage' during his first Pentagon briefing in six months [France 24], [Al Jazeera], [Globe and Mail]. The FBI is reportedly investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman US authorities believe to be a Chinese intelligence asset, though China has dismissed the allegations as 'groundless' ahead of a planned Trump-Xi meeting [BBC], [Globe and Mail]. In Southeast Asia, Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming has indicated his intention to resign amid controversies involving his credentials and alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo [Nikkei Asia]. Meanwhile, France has accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of orchestrating cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration systems and summoned Tehran's ambassador [RFI], warning of potential consequences including European sanctions.

top_stories.headline: Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks Begin in Abu Dhabi with US Mediation, Europeans Demand Seat at Table
bullets: Trilateral negotiations between Ukraine, Russia, and the United States commenced in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, with US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff leading the American delegation
US officials reported both Moscow and Kyiv are showing 'a little bit of flexibility' on control of Ukraine's eastern Donetsk region in potential postwar scenarios
France, UK, and Germany secured participation in the talks after European officials expressed concern about being excluded from discussions on collective security
Key disagreement remains over Donetsk, with Russia demanding Ukraine cede territory it still controls while Kyiv resists territorial concessions

top_stories.headline: Defense Secretary Hegseth Denounces Impeachment Effort Over Iran War as 'Sabotage'
bullets: Republican Representative Thomas Massie filed an impeachment resolution against Pete Hegseth on Monday, citing the war on Iran, strikes on alleged drug boats, and other actions
Hegseth held his first Pentagon press briefing in six months, calling the effort a 'farce' and 'political spectacle' by a defeated congressman
The resolution focuses primarily on the Iran conflict but also references military actions in Yemen against Houthi rebels and in Venezuela
President Trump defended Hegseth on Truth Social, calling him deserving of an 'A PLUS, PLUS, PLUS' and labeling Massie a 'TOTAL LOSER'

sources.framing_note: Framed as context of post-midterm Republican losses blamed partly on Iran conflict

sources.framing_note: Emphasized Massie's status as a Trump-opposed Republican who lost his primary

top_stories.headline: FBI Investigating Nvidia CEO's Relationship with Alleged Chinese Spy, Trump Confirms
bullets: President Trump confirmed the FBI is investigating Jensen Huang's affair with a woman US authorities believe was a Chinese intelligence asset
Huang told Trump he 'had no idea she was a spy' and Nvidia has commissioned an independent investigation, saying it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised
The revelation knocked approximately $250 billion off Nvidia's market value, making it the world's second most valuable company after Apple
China's Foreign Ministry dismissed the allegations as 'entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China'

sources.framing_note: Straightforward reporting on Trump's confirmation and FBI investigation

sources.framing_note: Provided extensive background on Alice Huang's business history and Megaspeed International's chip dealings; included China's pushback framing it as racial targeting

top_stories.headline: France Accuses Iran's Revolutionary Guards of Supermarket Cyberattacks, Summons Ambassador
bullets: France attributed October cyberattacks on approximately 700 supermarket refrigeration systems to Shahid Kaveh, an offensive cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps
Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot warned France would consider 'all proportionate measures' including non-public responses to deter further attacks
Paris prosecutors opened a judicial investigation targeting the head of Shahid Kaveh and two deputies, requesting international arrest warrants
France summoned Iran's ambassador and announced plans to propose new European-level sanctions against individuals and entities involved

sources.framing_note: Comprehensive coverage of diplomatic and legal responses

sources.framing_note: Article focused on explaining the Shahid Kaveh cyber unit

top_stories.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Offers Resignation Amid Diploma, Wiretapping Scandals
bullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming, son of former President Joko Widodo, has expressed intention to resign according to the presidential office
The resignation offer follows controversies over his high school diploma and alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto
The development signals a widening rift between President Prabowo and his predecessor Widodo
Gibran became vice president after the 2024 election that brought Prabowo to power

sources.framing_note: Framed as signaling breakdown in relationship between current and former presidents
